company.description:
Cityfurnish is an internet company that specializes in the fields of e-commerce and online rental. It features an online renting zone where contemporary and modern styles amalgamate to establish a new genre of wooden furniture and furnishings.

The company was founded in 2015 and headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $2,500,000, or 24.63% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,942,192 to $22,910,347, a 11.8x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
